lines.en: I shuffle in through the alley mouth.
I am not familiar with this place.

lines.zh: 地上有点滑，我走得很小心。
lines.en: The floor is slick; I tread carefully.
Every step, I sway once.
This body does not obey me.
I shuffle and glance both ways.
People see me and hide.
I wonder what they are hiding from.
I would like to ask myself the same.
The name, at least, I have.
A long one; it tangles the tongue.
I walk, and then I am there.
There is light at the alley's end.
So I head over there.
I stop at the wall corner.
This place smells very strange.
I try to plant my feet.
It takes a while.
Wind passes through the alley.
I sway with it.
There are other strange things here.
We ignore each other.
I open my mouth once.
But no sound comes.
That is not bad either.
I look up at the eaves.
There is moss on the tiles.
I have stepped on this stair three times.

lines.zh: 这么近，你的影子盖住我。
lines.en: This close, your shadow covers me.
You look normal.
That makes me uneasy.

lines.zh: 那东西弯弯的，是给我吃的吗？
lines.en: That curved thing in your hand. Is it for me?
I have never seen this before.
You take one step toward me.
And I step forward.
Let us call that a greeting.
Your face is a little familiar.
We surely have not met.
Your hand has gone back to your belt.
I do not like that movement.
You came out of that door.
I cannot get through that door.
I sway once, all of me.
That one hurt.
I lean on the wall.
Now I can stand.
Your arm is genuinely strong.
I have met this before.
I will take another if it comes.
I crouch down.
It takes a moment to rise.

lines.zh: 被打得转了两圈，我还没站稳。
lines.en: The blow spun me twice; I'm still not steady.
The thing in your hand.
It smells good.
I do not usually get such things.
Lower your hand a bit.
Somewhere I can reach.
You will regret this later.
But that is later.
That thing in your hand smells of oil.
I cannot help swallowing.
You saw that, did you not.
You ran straight into me.
We both swayed.
This alley is too narrow.
You go left, I go right.

lines.zh: 圆滚滚的身子挤过去，卡了一下。
lines.en: My round body squeezes past and gets stuck once.
I glance back at you.
You look back at me too.
You squeeze past my side.
My shoulder scrapes the wall.
A layer of dust falls from it.
I have not considered that.
In this shape it hardly comes up.
Ask something else.
Like why I am here.
I am not sure either.
There are only the two of us in this alley.
That came out a little fast.
Is my name not long enough already.

lines.zh: 我连自己长什么样都说不清。
lines.en: I cannot even describe my own looks.

lines.zh: 这问题你问别人会更好。
lines.en: You would do better asking someone else.
Something is lying on the ground.
I stare at it a while.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子拱了拱，它还是不动。
lines.en: I nudge it with my snout. Still it does not move.
I reach out to touch it.
Yet my hand will not reach.
Then let it go.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，又不知道该给谁。
lines.en: I pick it up and forget who it belongs to.
They reach out crooked.
That thing is by the wall base.
So I gave up.
You still have not put that down.
Then I take it you mean to give it.
But you will not give it.
Then I must take it myself.
There is something in your hand.
I see it quite clearly.
Raising it will not help.
This alley has only one exit.
You are standing in the wrong spot.
I moved first.
Do not be in a hurry to leave.
That thing in your hand swayed once.

lines.zh: 墙根没了，你只剩我这边。
lines.en: The wall is gone; only my side remains.
You can outwait this pace.
But I will not stop.
You have backed to the wall base.
There is no way past the wall.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往那边挪，靴子拖着地。
lines.en: I shuffle toward it, my boots dragging.
Slow, but in the right direction.
Your steps are going backward.
At the wall base there is nowhere left.
The light in the alley has not changed.
I am still some way from you.

lines.zh: 我这身子，走一步响一下。
lines.en: This body clanks with every step.

lines.zh: 我从巷子口挪进来，脚下打滑。
lines.en: I shuffle in from the alley, feet slipping.
That one was not heavy.
And I cannot keep my own footing.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，你退，我也跟着滑。
lines.en: I charge, you step back, and I slide after you.
That is the whole of my ability.
I reach out and push you.
You step back once.
I sway too.
Now we are even.
That push did not move you.
I was not in this place before.
Then I was standing here.
Who brought me here.
The alley answers with an echo.
Nobody answers.
Then I will walk about on my own.
I came from the other end of the alley.

lines.zh: 路上碰见几个像我一样的。
lines.en: I met a few like me on the way.

lines.zh: 四十点血，我们互相看了一会儿。
lines.en: Forty health, and we studied each other a while.
Then each went our own way.

lines.zh: 我到现在还没弄清这是哪。
lines.en: I still have not worked out where this is.
These wall bricks are new.
Fire comes and I duck toward the wall.
I land flat on the ground.
Water pours in; I claw at nothing.
I am thrown back several steps.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西扎在我身上。
lines.en: Something sharp sticks into me.
That light weakens my legs.
Hunger makes me sway more.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整个人一抖。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I jolt all over.
The ground underfoot is gone.
